_doc: L3 analyze ground truth = our self-consistent reproduction (3_reproduction/L3/result.json + auditor/l3_metrics.json), never the paper's numbers (the source figure prints none). The <z> truths are the record's native dimensionless <z>/d values converted to nm by multiplying with the full 155 nm computational stack thickness (55+45+55; kdotpy normalizes its z observable by the full stack).

_rules.anisotropy_contrast: documented 2(5) exception: PASS iff anisotropy_neg2e11_meV >= 2.0 AND anisotropy_pos2e11_meV >= 0 AND anisotropy_neg2e11_meV >= 3.0 * anisotropy_pos2e11_meV; individual magnitudes recorded as diagnostics, not toleranced
_rules.z_neg2e11: zmax_neg2e11_nm > 0 AND zmin_neg2e11_nm < 0 AND (zmax - zmin) >= 7.5 nm
_rules.z_pos2e11: zmax_pos2e11_nm > 0 AND zmin_pos2e11_nm < 0 AND (zmax - zmin) >= 7.5 nm

_provenance.pins: k* = 0.4 nm^-1, near-CNP window CNP0 +/- 25 meV, grid step <= 0.05 nm^-1 (record validates 0.02-0.05)
